industry.headline: Florida Presses Court to Force Meta to Redesign Instagram/Facebook for Teens, Rejecting $18B Settlement
industry.summary: Florida AG James Uthmeier, who refused to join Meta's recent $18B multistate settlement, is seeking a court-ordered injunction requiring Meta to identify and remove Florida users under 14 from Facebook/Instagram, cap teen usage at two hours/day, and disable autoplay and infinite scroll for minors, arguing Meta continues violating the state's 2024 child-protection law. Signals intensifying US regulatory pressure right as NOMO's US GTM launches, reinforcing the pitch for a pro-social-health, rewarded alternative.

industry.headline: Arizona AG Sues TikTok Over Teen Addiction Design
industry.summary: Arizona AG Kris Mayes sued TikTok and ByteDance over manipulative design (infinite scroll, autoplay, reward loops, push notifications), citing internal documents claiming screen-time controls 'did not work for teens,' and is pushing TikTok, Snapchat and YouTube toward two-hour daily limits and nighttime blocking — following Meta's $17B multistate settlement a month earlier. Validates NOMO's off-platform-rewards value proposition in its current US GTM market.

reconsider.name: BrainWin

reconsider.why_fits: <cite index="18-1,18-2">BrainWin is a screen time app for iPhone that blocks distracting apps and websites until the user earns access back by completing healthy real-life tasks such as walking, reading, exercising or studying, launched to reduce doomscrolling without giving up apps entirely</cite>, a close gamified-reward mechanic analogous to NOMO's Moments system.

reconsider.category: Municipal teen experiential pass (museums, zoo, arboretum, recreation venues)
reconsider.name: Dallas Park and Recreation — Teen All Access Pass
reconsider.reason: Duplicate of the higher-confidence Dallas Teen All-Access Pass entry already kept.
reconsider.why_fits: This is a city-run, teen-specific (ages 13-17) free-admission pass bundling a wide roster of experiential venues, precisely the kind of 'tradeable reward inventory' NOMO seeks beyond its current museum/concert partners. As described, 'Dallas Park and Recreation has teamed up with several area partners to offer teens age 13-17 FREE activities,' with participating venues including the Dallas Zoo, Dallas Arboretum, and a roller rink. Because it's a municipal program (not a single paid brand), it is realistic to approach and also double-dips into NOMO's Municipalities GTM vertical.

reconsider.why_fits: Sells bundled access to dozens of city attractions (museums, tours, sights) across major markets, similar in spirit to GetYourGuide and Fever already in NOMO's lineup, and offers a scalable, tradeable ticket inventory well suited to teen/Gen Z redemption rewards.

reconsider.why_fits: Blue Shield's BlueSky division already runs a teen-focused digital engagement initiative with a youth nonprofit, showing insurers are actively building teen digital-wellness programs — a genuine gap where NOMO could slot in as the behavior-change/rewards layer.
